title: Scalar extension and arbitrary cartesian open exchange
statement: For a cartesian square with open vertical morphisms j,j′ and arbitrary horizontal maps h,g, scalar extension along any commutative ring map commutes with open base change. Use the exact inverse-image comparisons and the open scalar inverse fixed in [def-pur-open-coefficient-normalizations], and the published degreewise-derived open base-change isomorphism. The displayed inverse-balancing/forward-exchange square commutes on every unbounded derived object, with no coefficient finiteness or flatness assumption.

source.place: Compatibility (3), Scalar extension and arbitrary cartesian open exchange

proof.text: Apply scalar pullback composition to the two factorizations of the diagonal. Cancel the common diagonal comparison, using the canonical square compositors; invert scalar comparisons to obtain the required pullback cube.

Derive the ordinary open exchange unit equation using the proved preservation of exact adjunction mates. The open scalar inverse has its defining unit transpose. Apply the abstract open scalar exchange lemma.

theorem etaleOpenScalarExchangeSquare
    {A B : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] (φ : A →+* B)
    {U' U T' T : Scheme.{u}} {h : U' ⟶ U} {j' : U' ⟶ T'}
    {j : U ⟶ T} {g : T' ⟶ T} [IsOpenImmersion j] [IsOpenImmersion j']
    (sq : IsPullback h j' j g) (M : DerivedCategoryModule A U) :
    (openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B) j').mapDerivedCategory.map
        ((properOpenCoefficientPullbackIso φ h).inv.app M) ≫
      (mapDerivedCategoryOpenImmersionLowerShriekBaseChangeIso
        (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B) sq).hom.app ((scalarExtension φ U).obj M) ≫
      (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B) g).mapDerivedCategory.map
        (properOpenCoefficientOpenInverse φ j M) =
      properOpenCoefficientOpenInverse φ j'
        ((upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) h).mapDerivedCategory.obj M) ≫
      (scalarExtension φ T').map
        ((mapDerivedCategoryOpenImmersionLowerShriekBaseChangeIso
          (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) sq).hom.app M) ≫
      (properOpenCoefficientPullbackIso φ g).inv.app
        ((openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) j).mapDerivedCategory.obj M)
